description: In AlwaysVisible mode, moving the cursor from an icon outside the dock or running the Toggle Dock action does not change the panel position or opacity.

assertions.comment: The opacity of the unnamed panel path (0/0/2) remains 1.0 after the cursor leaves and after the Toggle Dock action.
The AlwaysVisible panel stays at display position y=36 when the cursor leaves and when a toggle is requested.
The dock panel remains fully visible after enough time has passed since the toggle action.
The AlwaysVisible dock window remains visible through the end of the scenario.
